table.name: cards
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering card printing (MTGJSON-style card data): name, artist, set, rarity, mana cost, rules text, identifiers, and print/availability flags.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer row identifier for this card printing.

col_002.name: artist
col_002.description: Name of the card's illustrator (e.g. John Avon, Kev Walker).

col_003.description: Card names (El-Hajjaj, Bosium Strip, Lim-Dul's High Guard), populated for only ~26 rows, mostly early Arabian Nights-style cards. Possibly an alternate/original name field, but the evidence does not clearly identify it.

col_004.name: availability
col_004.description: Comma-separated list of platforms the printing is available on: paper, mtgo, arena, shandalar.

col_005.name: borderColor
col_005.description: Card border color: black, white, gold, silver, borderless.

col_006.description: Numeric external card identifier (39000-241899), null for ~49% of rows; one-to-one match with rows in t02/t03. Likely a platform-specific card id (e.g. Arena or MTGO id), but which platform is unclear.

col_007.description: Numeric external card identifier (10000-241662), null for ~24% of rows; one-to-one match with rows in t02/t03. Likely a platform-specific card id (e.g. MTGO or Arena id), counterpart to col_006.

col_008.name: colors
col_008.description: Mana colors of the card as comma-separated W/U/B/R/G codes.

col_009.name: colorIndicator
col_009.description: Color indicator (W/U/B/R/G codes) printed on the card face; present only on a few cards (e.g. back faces of double-faced cards).

col_010.name: colorIdentity
col_010.description: Color identity (W/U/B/R/G codes) used for deck-building rules (e.g. Commander); empty for most lands.

col_011.name: manaValue
col_011.description: Converted mana cost / mana value; mostly 0-14, with an outlier of 1000000 (a joke card).

col_012.name: duelDeck
col_012.description: Duel Deck side marker: 'a' or 'b' for cards belonging to a Duel Deck pair.

col_013.description: Integer id referencing rows in t02, t03 and t04 (many-to-one). Likely an internal foreign key (e.g. to a related entity such as rulings/tokens/sets), but the target meaning is unclear.

col_015.name: faceName
col_015.description: Name of a specific face of a multi-face card (Fire/Ice, Nezumi Graverobber, Elbrus the Binding Blade).

col_016.name: flavorName
col_016.description: Flavor/alternate display name, here the Godzilla-series alternate names (Godzilla, Rodan, Spacegodzilla, etc.).

col_017.name: flavorText
col_017.description: Flavor text printed on the card.

col_018.name: frameEffects
col_018.description: Comma-separated frame effect tags: legendary, extendedart, showcase, nyxtouched, miracle, snow, etc.

col_019.name: frameVersion
col_019.description: Card frame version by year: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, or 'future'.

col_021.description: Boolean flag, true for only 12 rows. Candidate: isTextless, but not confirmable.

col_022.description: Boolean flag, true for 29 rows. Candidate: isOversized, but not confirmable.

col_023.description: Boolean flag, true for ~61% of rows. Candidate: foil availability (or a similar print-run flag); exact meaning unclear.

col_024.description: Boolean flag, true for ~90% of rows. Candidate: nonfoil availability; exact meaning unclear.

col_025.description: Boolean flag, true for 288 rows. Candidate: isFullArt; not confirmable.

col_026.description: Boolean flag, true for 486 rows. Candidate: isTimeshifted; not confirmable.

col_027.description: Boolean flag, true for ~4733 rows. Candidate: isPromo; not confirmable.

col_028.description: Boolean flag, true for 402 rows. Candidate: isStorySpotlight; not confirmable.

col_029.description: Boolean flag, true for ~5588 rows. Candidate: isReserved (Reserved List card); not confirmable.

col_030.description: Boolean flag, true for ~59% of rows. Candidate: isReprint or a foil-related flag; exact meaning unclear.

col_031.description: Boolean flag, true for 1333 rows. Candidate: isOnlineOnly; not confirmable.

col_032.description: Boolean flag, true for ~28% of rows. Candidate: isAlternative / alternate-art flag; not confirmable.

col_036.name: keywords
col_036.description: Comma-separated keyword abilities: Flying, Trample, Cycling, Equip, etc.

col_037.name: layout
col_037.description: Card layout: normal, transform, modal_dfc, split, adventure, leveler, scheme, augment, etc.

col_038.name: leadershipSkills
col_038.description: Serialized dict of format legality as a commander: brawl / commander / oathbreaker booleans.

col_039.name: life
col_039.description: Life modifier, likely for Vanguard cards (values -8..30, mostly negative); only populated on a tiny subset.

col_040.name: hand
col_040.description: Hand-size modifier or similar stat (0-20, with dice-notation values like '1d4+1' and '*'), populated on ~1.5% of rows; likely a special-card stat field.

col_041.name: manaCost
col_041.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. {1}{W}, {R/G}{R/G}.

col_042.name: tcgplayerProductId
col_042.description: Numeric product identifier (up to 535593) referencing t03; likely the TCGplayer product id.

col_043.description: Numeric identifier referencing t03/t02 (many-to-one); likely a store/product id (e.g. Cardmarket), exact source unclear.

col_044.description: Numeric identifier in the 6993-76889 range on ~10% of rows; likely a store-specific id (e.g. Cardmarket/CardKingdom), exact source unclear.

col_045.name: id
col_045.description: Unique UUID (version-5 style) per row; likely the card-level 'id' identifier (oracle-level UUID) distinct from the printing uuid in col_072.

col_046.description: Integer id referencing t02/t03/t04 (many-to-one); internal foreign key, target meaning unclear.

col_047.description: Integer id referencing t02/t03/t04 (many-to-one); internal foreign key, target meaning unclear.

col_048.description: Numeric identifier (up to 508409) on ~74% of rows; likely another store/product id, exact source unclear.

col_049.name: name
col_049.description: Card name (e.g. Stoneforge Mystic, Plains, Mons's Goblin Raiders).

col_050.name: number
col_050.description: Collector number within the set; includes alphanumeric codes like 'br79', 'jf324'.

col_051.name: releaseDate
col_051.description: Specific release date (YYYY/M/D), populated mainly for promos/special printings outside set releases; range 1993-2021.

col_052.name: originalText
col_052.description: Original (as-first-printed) rules text; includes old wording and single-letter color codes for old cards.

col_053.name: originalType
col_053.description: Original (as-first-printed) type line, e.g. 'Summon - Fungus', 'Creature — Kor Artificer'.

col_054.description: UUIDs on ~2.4% of rows, near-unique; likely a Scryfall id for a related object (emblem/token/back), but not confirmable.

col_055.name: power
col_055.description: Creature power; mostly small integers, with special values like '∞' and '2+*'.

col_056.name: printings
col_056.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which the card has been printed (e.g. 2XM, PRM, LEA).

col_057.name: promoTypes
col_057.description: Promo type tags: prerelease, datestamped, setpromo, boxtopper, mediainsert, convention, etc.

col_058.name: purchaseUris
col_058.description: Serialized dict of purchase links per store (cardKingdom, cardKingdomFoil, cardmarket, tcgplayer) via mtgjson.com redirect links.

col_059.name: rarity
col_059.description: Printing rarity: common, uncommon, rare, mythic.

col_060.name: scryfallId
col_060.description: Scryfall card id (UUID), nearly unique per printing (a few duplicates from multi-face cards).

col_061.name: scryfallIllustrationId
col_061.description: Scryfall illustration id (UUID), shared across printings with the same art.

col_062.name: scryfallOracleId
col_062.description: Scryfall oracle id (UUID), shared across all printings of the same card (e.g. 693 printings of a basic land share one id).

col_063.name: setCode
col_063.description: Set code of this printing (MB1, PRM, 10E, TSP...); references t06.col_005.

col_064.name: side
col_064.description: Face letter for multi-face cards: a, b, c, d, e.

col_065.name: subtypes
col_065.description: Comma-separated creature/sub types: Kor, Artificer, Goblin, Forest, Aura, etc.

col_066.name: supertypes
col_066.description: Supertypes: Legendary, Basic, Snow, World, Ongoing.

col_067.description: Integer id referencing t03/t02 (many-to-one); internal/external identifier, exact meaning unclear.

col_068.name: text
col_068.description: Current rules text of the card (including reminder text and mana symbols).

col_069.name: toughness
col_069.description: Creature toughness; mostly small integers, with special values like '*+1'.

col_070.name: type
col_070.description: Full current type line, e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer', 'Basic Land — Plains'.

col_071.name: types
col_071.description: Comma-separated main card types: Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Artifact, Enchantment, Summon, Conspiracy.

col_072.name: uuid
col_072.description: Unique per-printing UUID; referenced by t02, t03 and t04, i.e. the main printing identifier used as foreign key by other tables.

col_073.name: otherFaceIds
col_073.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of the other faces of a multi-face card.

col_074.name: watermark
col_074.description: Card watermark: faction names (mirran, phyrexian, golgari, dimir, izzet) or set-based watermarks like 'set (FEM)'.

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized card text table (Magic: The Gathering style): one row per card printing per language, holding the card's name, rules text, type line, and flavor text translated into that language. Each row links to a base card record in t01 via a UUID.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Auto-incrementing primary key for this table; unique integer identifier of each localized card-text row.

col_002.name: flavor_text
col_002.description: Flavor text of the card in the row's language; empty string when the card has none. Values are quotes/lore sentences in many languages.

col_003.name: language
col_003.description: Language of this translation (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew, Portuguese (Brazil)).

col_004.name: multiverseid
col_004.description: Numeric card printing identifier (Gatherer multiverseid) linking this localized text to a specific printed card edition; null for printings without one. Range ~73k–507k, mostly unique per row.

col_005.name: card_name
col_005.description: Localized name of the card (e.g. 'Pacifismo', '霊緒の振り子', 'Zyklop vom Blutfelsen').

col_006.name: rules_text
col_006.description: Localized rules/ability text of the card, including keyword abilities (Flying/Vol/Fliegend/飛行) and full rules paragraphs; empty for cards without rules text.

col_007.name: type_line
col_007.description: Localized card type line (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop', 'Criatura Lendária — Guerreiro Goblin', 'Spontanzauber' = Instant); empty for some card types.

col_008.name: card_uuid
col_008.description: UUID of the card (Scryfall-style deterministic UUID) that this localized text belongs to; references t01.col_072. Repeated ~10 times per UUID, once per language.

table.name: card_format_legality
table.purpose: One row per (card, format) pair recording the card's legality status in that Magic: The Gathering format. The card UUID references a cards table (t01). Formats include commander, legacy, vintage, duel, modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny, etc., with statuses Legal, Banned, Restricted.

col_001.name: legality_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key; sequential integer 1..427907 with no gaps, one per row.

col_002.name: format
col_002.description: MTG tournament format name (commander, legacy, vintage, duel, modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny, etc.). 15 distinct formats.

col_003.name: legality_status
col_003.description: Legality of the card in the given format: Legal, Banned, or Restricted (restricted applies to vintage-style formats where only one copy is allowed).

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID (version 5 style) identifying the card; references t01.col_072 (the cards table). Each card appears once per format (top count 15 matches the 15 formats).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: Card rulings for a Magic: The Gathering card database: each row is one rules clarification/ruling text attached to a specific card, with the date the ruling was issued/made effective. Referenced by other tables (e.g. t01) via the ruling id.

col_001.name: ruling_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique sequential integer id for each ruling (1 to 87769). Referenced by t01 and t06.

col_002.name: ruling_date
col_002.description: Date the ruling was published/issued, ranging from 2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05. The heavy concentration on 2004-10-04 (6334 rows) suggests a bulk import of older rulings on that date.

col_003.name: ruling_text
col_003.description: The text of the rules ruling/clarification for a card (MTG oracle-style rulings explaining card interactions).

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID of the card the ruling applies to; references t01.col_072 (the card table). Multiple rulings can share the same card UUID.

table.name: set_name_translations
table.purpose: Localized (translated) names of Magic: The Gathering sets/expansions, one row per set per language (121 sets x 10 languages = 1210 rows). Set codes like RTR (Return to Ravnica), EVE (Eventide), DDR (Duel Deck: Nissa vs Ob Nixilis) and names like 'Archenemy', 'Battle Royale', 'Beatdown' confirm MTG sets; col_004 holds the set name translated into the language in col_002 (e.g. 'Ritorno a Ravnica' is Italian for Return to Ravnica).

col_001.name: translation_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key, sequential integer 1-1210, one per row.

col_002.name: language
col_002.description: Language of the translated set name; 10 distinct values (Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, etc.), each appearing 121 times (once per set).

col_003.name: set_code
col_003.description: Magic: The Gathering set/expansion code (e.g. RTR = Return to Ravnica, EVE = Eventide, DDR = a Duel Deck set); references the set lookup table t06.col_005.

col_004.name: translated_set_name
col_004.description: Name of the MTG set translated into the language given in col_002 (e.g. 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Italian 'Return to Ravnica', 'イーブンタイド' = Japanese 'Eventide'). Null for ~19% of rows, i.e. sets not released/translated in that language.

table.name: sets
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering card set/expansion/product release (Scryfall-style 'sets' table): set code, name, type, release date, block, booster contents, and flags. Referenced by card tables via the set code (col_005).

col_001.name: set_id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer id of the set row (1-551).

col_002.name: block_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to a blocks/parent-entity table (t01/t02/t03); many sets share the same block (e.g. 43 sets in block 5). 0 for sets with no block.

col_003.name: block_name
col_003.description: Name of the block the set belongs to ('Theros', 'Kamigawa', 'Shadows over Innistrad') or a grouping label ('Core Set', 'Commander', 'Friday Night Magic'). Null for ~half the sets (those with no block).

col_004.name: booster_contents
col_004.description: JSON description of booster pack contents (slot distribution: basic/common/uncommon/rare/rareMythic counts, per product variant such as 'default' or 'arena'). Null for non-booster products.

col_005.name: set_code
col_005.description: Unique 2-5 character set code (e.g. '10E', 'TSP', 'PGRN', 'PWP09'). Referenced by card tables t01.col_063 and t05.col_003.

col_006.name: is_digital
col_006.description: Boolean flag, true for ~30% of sets; plausibly 'digital-only set' (MTGO/Arena releases).

col_008.name: is_foil_only
col_008.description: Boolean flag, true for ~19% of sets; plausibly 'foil-only release' (e.g. premium/promo sets).

col_009.name: is_nonfoil_only
col_009.description: Boolean flag, true for ~5% of sets; plausibly 'nonfoil-only release'.

col_011.name: mtgo_code
col_011.description: Code used on Magic Online; 'DEFAULT'/'DCI'/'PMEI' appear for promo/memorabilia groups, otherwise mirrors the set code.

col_012.name: parent_set_id
col_012.description: Integer id (4-3660) present for ~36% of sets, one-to-one with rows in t01/t02/t03; plausibly a link to a parent/master set (e.g. promo sets pointing to their source expansion).

col_014.name: parent_set_name
col_014.description: Human-readable name matching the parent set referenced by col_012 ('Aether Revolt', 'Ultimate Masters', ...); null when col_012 is null.

col_015.name: parent_set_code
col_015.description: Set code of the parent set (mirrors col_012/col_014); null for ~71% of rows.

col_016.name: set_name
col_016.description: Full unique name of the set/product ('Ultimate Masters', 'Magic 2010', 'Two-Headed Giant Tournament').

col_017.name: block_code
col_017.description: Short code of the block the set belongs to (e.g. 'ZNR' shared by 6 sets of the Zendikar Rising block); null for most sets. Could alternatively be a reprint-base set code.

col_018.name: released_at
col_018.description: Release date of the set, ranging 1993-08-05 (Alpha) to 2021-03-19; Jan-1 dates for undated promos.

col_019.name: card_count
col_019.description: Integer present for ~47% of sets; top value 62 repeated 21 times suggests a count (plausibly number of cards in the set) rather than a true key, though it also matches ids in t02/t03/t04.

col_020.name: block_id_alt
col_020.description: Near-duplicate of col_002 (same top values and range, 181 vs 166 distinct); likely a second/normalized block reference. Relationship to col_002 unclear.
